verdict.rationale: An llms.txt index exists at platform.kimi.ai/docs/llms.txt, and the platform docs are served as markdown pages agents can read. However, it covers only the Kimi API Open Platform, which the vendor treats as a separate product; kimi.com's llms.txt redirects to the SPA root, and the assistant app has no docs site. Missing for 10: an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs for the Kimi assistant and Kimi Code, and independent or hands-on evidence of agents consuming the platform llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: The real llms.txt at platform.kimi.ai/docs/llms.txt belongs to the Kimi API Open Platform
these absences are grounded in the full llms.txt index
